Hello DEV community! 👋

For the past few weeks, I’ve been working on a project very close to my heart: EduScreen.

🧠 The Problem

Many students struggle quietly in school with learning difficulties like ADHD, Dyslexia, or Dyscalculia. Unfortunately, getting a professional screening is often expensive, intimidating, or inaccessible for many parents and schools.

💡 The Solution

To bridge this gap, I built EduScreen — a 100% free, private, and open-source preliminary assessment tool. There are no paywalls and absolutely no data tracking.

🛠️ Tech Stack

I built this as a lightweight, fast web application using:

• HTML5

• CSS3

• Vanilla JavaScript

• Hosted entirely on GitHub Pages

🚀 Try it out!

I am a solo developer, and I built this to create some social impact. I would absolutely love your honest feedback!

👉 Live Demo: https://aryanbarnvanshi-dev.github.io/Not-Weak-Mind/

👉 GitHub Repo: https://github.com/aryanbarnvanshi-dev/Not-Weak-Mind

Please test the UI/UX, try to break it, and let me know how I can improve the flow or the codebase! Thank you. 🙏
